intention.title: Make a solid intention
intention.duaDesc: Ask Allah for help. Day and night keep supplicating to make it easy for you.
intention.sakeTitle: Do it for the sake of Allah
intention.sakeDesc: Make a solid intention. Do it only for the sake of Allah!
intention.tip: 💡 Tip: Avoid major and minor sins. 'Verily, knowledge is a light and the light of Allah is not given to a sinner'.

dailyGoals.title: Daily Goals & Streaks
dailyGoals.p1Desc: Finish all your selected tasks every day to maintain your streak.
dailyGoals.p2Desc: Challenge yourself to set new personal records. Each day counts!
dailyGoals.tip: 💡 Completing all daily tasks keeps your streak alive. Start small with one or two tasks and build momentum.

quickTest.title: Use Quick Test Often
quickTest.p1: Use the 'Do a Quick Test' task to strengthen your memorization. Recording yourself reciting from memory helps identify weak areas.
quickTest.p2: After recording, listen back and mark any mistakes. This reinforces your memory and prevents regressions.
quickTest.tip: 💡 Tip: Record yourself 3 times for each set of verses. Listen attentively and mark all mistakes.

reviseMistakes.title: Revise Pages with Mistakes
reviseMistakes.p1: After correcting a mistake in a verse, recite that verse 20-50 times to permanently fix it in your memory.
reviseMistakes.p2: Use the 'Revise from Memory' task to systematically review your memorized pages and catch any errors.
reviseMistakes.tip: 💡 Tip: Spaced repetition is key. Review mistakes multiple times over several days for better retention.

startSmall.title: Start Small
startSmall.p1: Begin with a small manageable quantity, it could be as small as a single verse! But be consistent. Once comfortable you can increase it later.
startSmall.p2: For example, you can start with 0.25 pages per day (approximately 4 lines, not verses).
startSmall.p3: Once this becomes comfortable, gradually increase your daily target. Building consistent habits matters more than speed.
startSmall.tip: 💡 Tip: You can configure your pages per day in Settings. Adjust it as you progress.

dailyRevision.title: Don't miss your daily revision it's a must
dailyRevision.p1: You must complete this one task daily to keep your hifz solid and mistake free.
dailyRevision.p2: Revising what you already know is more important than learning new verses. So, prioritize this task over the new memorization in busy days.
dailyRevision.tip: 💡 Tip: Set a manageable target (finish revision in X days) in settings to rotate revisions efficiently.

listenBefore.title: Listen Before Memorizing
listenBefore.p1: Before starting memorization, listen to the target verses from your favorite reciter 5-10 times.
listenBefore.p2: This helps you avoid tajweed mistakes and familiarize yourself with the correct pronunciation and rhythm.
listenBefore.tip: 💡 Tip: Choose a reciter whose style resonates with you. Consistency helps with memorization.

stepProcess.title: Step-by-Step Memorization Process
stepProcess.item1: Recite verse 1 from memory 20 times without mistakes
stepProcess.item2: Learn verse 2 and recite it 20 times confidently
stepProcess.item3: Combine verses 1 & 2 and recite together 20 times
stepProcess.item4: Learn verse 3 and recite it 20 times without mistakes
stepProcess.item6: Record yourself reciting this set 3 times
stepProcess.item7: Listen attentively to your recordings and mark any mistakes
stepProcess.item8: Review mistakes before moving to the next set
stepProcess.item9: Mark page memorized - Once finished, press the memorize button to mark the page as memorized
stepProcess.item10: Record & verify - Test your memorization by recording audio to check for any mistakes
stepProcess.item11: Mark as perfect - After successful recording with no mistakes, click the perfect button to track your hifz status
stepProcess.item12: Track word mistakes - Tap on any word you make a mistake on, it will automatically adjust your hifz status for that page
stepProcess.tip: 💡 Some sheikhs/ustadhs recommend 50 times. This method makes your hifz solid and long-lasting. Quality over quantity!

focus.title: 🎯 Focus on Quality
focus.desc: Perfect memorization of 3 verses is better than weak memorization of 10.

consistency.title: 📅 Consistency is Key
consistency.desc: Complete your daily goals every day. Small daily efforts build lasting habits.

review.title: 🔄 Review Regularly
review.desc: Use the 'Recite from Memory' task to review. Spaced repetition strengthens retention.

record.title: 📢 Record & Listen
record.desc: Recording yourself is a powerful tool. Mistakes are easier to spot in playback.
